newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP slides on Prescott comments.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP slides on Prescott comments.

text.p: Shares in Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd (BHP) slid 16 cents lower to A$16.68 in active early afternoon trade after managing director John Prescott said the copper price was a real challenge for BHP and that world steel market conditions may be getting worse.
Before the comments were reported, BHP's share price had fallen 14 cents from its A$16.934 open.
The overall sharemarket, in which BHP has the largest weighting, was higher at the end of morning trade.
Several leading brokerage firms have also issued bearish research reports on the company in recent days.
"It's all the press coverage about the downgrades and there are a few institutions getting nervous," said one Sydney broker.
"Prescott's comments have just helped that process along," he said.
"There's a couple of institution selling orders in there today," said Eyres Reed broker Martin Angel.
"Institutions are just looking for a reason to sell," Angell said of the selloff after Prescott's comments.
